title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - JURADO) relative to amending the Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA) with 94B, LLC for the development of the City-owned property…
text:
[Council File 11-0054-S3; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - JURADO) relative to amending the Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA) with 94B, LLC for the development of the City-owned property located at 9402-9422 South Broadway.
Recommendation for Council action:
AUTHORIZE the Community Investment Department (CID) to amend the Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA) with 94B, LLC, relative to the development of the City-owned property located at 9402-9422 South Broadway, in order to extend the term of the ENA to June 1, 2027, with a potential future extension of 6 months, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
